name: São João do Oeste (Brazil)
description: Horizontal stripes of light blue, red, yellow, red and green in the proportions 6:1:2:1:6, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the municipal arms reading 12-12 SÃO JOÃO DO OESTE 1991.
history: São João do Oeste is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 26 April 1993 (prescribed with the arms by Municipal Law No. 61 of 26 April 1993, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, maize and a landscape, reading 12-12 SÃO JOÃO DO OESTE 1991
